notes.title: A Free Update On My Vow to My Liege: New Chibi CGs!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for supporting "My Vow to My Liege"! We've just updated 4 free chibi CGs to celebrate our game's 2nd anniversary, wish you all enjoy it and have an amazing gaming experience!

To unlock the new chibi CGs, you would need to walk through 4 specific plots where the CGs are located respectively. They are all in the first 7 chapters of the common route, and you may find the fast forward button useful:)

notes.title: New update on the live-streaming restriction of MVTML and other modifications
notes.notes:
1. The first 10 chapters of the common route are now unlocked for walk through videos and livestreaming.
2. Reported typos are corrected.
3. Fixed the error on the relationship status of YiGuang's route in the relation chart.
4. Slightly modified some of the script writings and the plots.

notes.title: Version 1.08 is updated.
notes.notes:
1/ Fixed the mistakenly cropped screen margins in ChenFeng's Chapter 16.

2/ Correct some of the text errors.

notes.title: Version 1.07 is updated.
notes.notes:
1/ Fixed game lag and slow performance issue on the previous version.

2/ We have received feedback which request adding a SFX volume's contolling function. However, we hope you would understand that we are using a third-party game engine which does not support such a function. Instead, we have lowered the volumn of all SFX for 6dB in this update. Hope this will improve your gaming experience.

notes.title: Version 1.06 is updated. (Especially for the English achievements)
notes.notes:
1/ To unlock “Storyteller”, please go to “Extra”>”Replay”, click into GouJian’s event XII, then return  to “Replay”.

2/ To unlock “Decay”, please walk through the plot in Chapter 5 that Fuchai returned from the underworld and discovered the blackened petal of the Sacred Seal. 

We apologize for any trouble that may have caused you. Please do not hesitate to contact us if anything goes wrong again.

notes.title: Version 1.05 is updated.
notes.notes:
1/ Fixed the bug of ChenFeng's event XI in Replay.
2/ “Back to the Past” & “The Storyteller” can now be unlocked accordingly.

PS Please do not hesitate to contact the developer if you are still unable to unlock the achievements.

notes.title: Version 1.04 is updated
notes.notes:
-YiGuang's and GouJian's Replay is now correctly shown. To regain the missing events, please walk though the plots in the two routes accordingly. (You may find the "Skip" button handy^^)

-The bug of Wu ZiXu's missing CG is fixed. 

-Wu ZiXu's letter is added into the Gallery. To unlock it, please walk through the plot of reading the letter in YiGunag's or ChengFeng's route.

-According to some players, their screens turned black in-game after they updated the game. But please rest assure that this should happen only on rare occasions. 
As for those palyers experiening the problem, please go to your library on steam and right click on the game in the menu on the left. Choose "Properties", then go on to the "Local Files" tab and chick on "Browse Local Files". Look into the local folders and delete the two files with ".sav" in their names, then restart the game. [* Please be aware that you will lose ALL your game saves after deleting the two files.]

notes.title: Version 1.03 is updated.
notes.notes:
Fixinig the bug of the overlapping of names in the naming interface which will occur after refreshing the interface for certian times. In addition to how to gain the new Steam Achievenments added in Version 1.02:

1/ "The Artist": After collecting ALL the CGs, please click into "Extra"> "Gallery".

2/ "The Storyteller": After walking through GouJian's event XII, “Lover or Liar”, in his BE route, please click into  "Extra" > "Replay".
